differences.native: MySQL orders by the date and uses RANGE INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING.
differences.app: SQLite orders by julianday(post_date) and uses the numeric RANGE 6 PRECEDING.
differences.rationale: SQLite does not support MySQL interval syntax in a RANGE frame. Both frames cover the same inclusive seven calendar days; February filtering, weekly average, burst threshold, grouping, and ordering are identical.
